subject.title: feat(ledger): add immutable action history core

question: Should ClawSweeper stabilize this broad schema-v1 ledger contract before any production workflow lane consumes it?
rationale: The patch creates long-lived persistence, privacy, and identity boundaries; only maintainers can decide whether to freeze those boundaries before integrated usage validates the minimum contract.

options.title: Stabilize after integrated proof
options.body: Keep the draft open, instrument one representative lane, and approve schema v1 after an end-to-end artifact validates the full lifecycle.

options.title: Merge the isolated core
options.body: Accept the unconsumed schema and helper surface now while owning possible migrations or contract changes during follow-up instrumentation.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Reduce schema v1 and exported helpers to the minimum required by the first production consumer.

recommendation.title: Stabilize after integrated proof
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open, instrument one representative lane, and approve schema v1 after an end-to-end artifact validates the full lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows the strongest ownership signal across the sweep workflow and durable automation architecture affected by this choice.
